authorization: User authorized beginning the medium-scale expansion after discussion of the new skeleton-token vocabulary. The primary objective is a reusable generated skeleton identity/structure sequence, with target-mesh localization providing supervision and use. This is a bounded frozen-feature experiment, not formal full-dataset retraining. Preserve all prior models and artifacts; review each stage before the next; no automatic retry or promotion.

baseline.scope: Fresh medium-task initialization from the old base, not continuation of the eight-asset overfit. Current manifests are used, including UniMate additions. Held-out frames are unseen to THIS probe; the inherited base model may have seen some base-asset frames before. Report base/addition strata separately and do not claim full-history pose holdout.

features.cache_boundary: Independent per-frame surface tokens and raw tracks before temporal encoding or u/O/M evidence. Two mesh-only query charts per training asset; a third source bank contains only the eight held-out raw frames and is evaluation-only. Recompute temporal/evidence features after selecting actual T. Target geometry is independently normalized per mesh. Save one large shard per asset on verified compute-node NVMe; keep only one asset in process memory.
features.original_motion_evidence: Keep original bias_h8 and all u/c/d channels, with no relation adapter or GT-derived conditioning.

data.partition: Partition original 40-frame NPZ indices by an asset-specific deterministic seed before any query, surface, or evidence selection. The 32 training-eligible frames provide both source banks and all XYZ training targets. The eight held-out frames never enter the current optimization; validation assets never enter optimization. Canonical NPZs and final manifests are unchanged. Keep every target joint and its ordered identity.
data.quantization: Unchanged strict 256-bin [-1,1] quantizer with mesh-only 1.1 padding. All 320 assets/all 40 frames were audited: unpadded training maxabs1.07687545 and validation1.01399255. No clipping, GT-derived per-instance scale, filtering or new root.

Real min/max-J train/valid cases exercise T2/T8/T24, both query charts, and the evaluation-only heldout source. Require cached tensor roundtrip, prefix parity, sequence save/rebinding, positive localization gradients into structure, all five component updates, frozen features unchanged, and T24/J512/32target stress below90% GPU memory and CPU peak below90% of64GiB. This is execution acceptance only.
